cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Expressive skills enable a dancer to communicate meaning, mood and intention to the audience

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Projection is the ability to reach out to the audience with energy and presence, making the performance compelling to watch

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Focus is the direction of the dancer's gaze and attention, guiding the audience's eye and expressing intention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Musicality is the dancer's response to the music, showing awareness of rhythm, tempo, accents and phrasing through movement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Communication is the overall ability to convey the choreographic intention and emotional content to the audience

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Phrasing is the way a dancer shapes a sequence of movements, like sentences in speech, to create meaning and dynamics

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: A dancer with good projection fills the performance space and holds the audience's attention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Focus can be directed outward to the audience, inward to reflect emotion, or at a partner to show relationship

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Musicality is not just about being on the beat — it includes highlighting accents, reflecting dynamics and using silence

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Phrasing groups movements into meaningful units, using breath, dynamics and timing to create contrast and emphasis

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: Expressive skills depend on physical and technical skills being secure enough to allow the dancer to focus on communication

cards.front: Recall a key point about Expressive Skills in Dance
cards.back: AQA 8236 examiners assess expressive skills as a key part of the performance component
